name: FSLogix
description: Windows MDM settings in the FSLogix category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Clean-up Invalid Sessions
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Cleans out registry keys in the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE hive that refer to a users SID.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Apps\CleanupInvalidSessions
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: Roam Recycle Bin
properties.description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Creates a redirection for the user's specific Recycle Bin into the VHD(x) container. Limited to the Recycle Bin on the System Drive only.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Apps\RoamRecycleBin
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: VHD Compact Disk
properties.description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Compacts the VHD disk during the sign-out operation and is designed to automatically decrease the Size On Disk of the user's container(s) depending on a pre-defined threshold.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Apps\VHDCompactDisk
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
